g.text: UML Use Case Diagram: Level 2 – Subsystem 3.0 (Field Operations Management)
Primitive Functional Decomposition aligned with DFD Level 2 (3.1 to 3.4)
Livestock Husbandry, Agronomic Tasks & Field Conditions
Consumables Calculation, Stock Verification & Automated Deduction
Health Protocols, Cultivation Schedules & Automated Calendar Alerts
Activity Draft Review, Manager Approval & Discrepancy Rejection
Stock Reconcile (2.2) and Financial Ledger Operational Expenses (4.1)
